item.title: Jigokudani Snow Monkey Park: Wild Macaques Bathing in Hot Springs — Guide
item.description: Jigokudani Snow Monkey Park is famous worldwide as the only place where wild Japanese macaques (snow monkeys) regularly bathe in natural hot springs, soaking in a steaming pool to keep warm, most iconically surrounded by deep snow in winter. Reached by a roughly 30-minute walk along a forest trail from the car park, the park lets visitors observe the wild troop up close as they relax, groom and play around the pool, an experience possible year-round but at its most magical and photogenic when snow blankets the valley.
